itinerary.title: Hanoi Arrival, West Lake, Temple of Literature & Water Puppets
itinerary.subtitle: Parents land DEL at 05:30 AM; BLR group lands 08:45 AM. Unified 09:30 AM pickup by private 9-seater DCar limousine.
itinerary.seniorTip: Flat walking around lake; VIP Water Puppet theatre is fully indoor seated.
itinerary.keyVegMeal: Sadhu Buddhist Vegetarian Fine Dining (L) & Namaste Hanoi (D)
atAGlanceHighlights: 🌅 Morning: Unified 09:30 AM Airport Pickup in private 9-seater DCar & Hotel Check-in
☀️ Afternoon: Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum photo stop, One Pillar Pagoda, Tran Quoc Pagoda & Temple of Literature
🌙 Evening: Café Giảng Egg Coffee, VIP Water Puppet Theatre show & Sadhu Gourmet Veg dinner

places.name: Noi Bai Airport (HAN T2 Pickup)
places.desc: Unified family pickup at Terminal 2 Arrivals Pillar 10. Board dedicated Ford Transit 9-seater VIP Limousine.

transitToNext.desc: Expressway drive into Hanoi Old Quarter

places.name: La Siesta Classic Ma May (Check-in)
places.desc: Welcome herbal drink, luggage drop, freshen up in double + triple suites.

transitToNext.desc: Private DCar drive to Ba Dinh district

places.name: Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum & One Pillar Pagoda
places.desc: Iconic Ba Dinh Square photo stop and the historic 11th-century One Pillar Pagoda built over a square lotus pond.

places.name: Sadhu Vegetarian Restaurant (Fine Dining)
places.desc: Gourmet Buddhist plant-based feast. Try tofu in passion fruit sauce, lotus seed fried rice, and pumpkin soup.

places.name: Tran Quoc Pagoda (West Lake)
places.desc: Oldest Buddhist temple in Hanoi (6th century) set on a picturesque islet in scenic West Lake.

places.name: Temple of Literature (Văn Miếu)
places.desc: Vietnam's first university founded in 1070. Peaceful courtyards, ancient turtle stelae, and Confucius shrine.

places.name: Café Giảng (Original Egg Coffee)
places.desc: Birthplace of Vietnamese Egg Coffee (Cà Phê Trứng) since 1946. Whipped egg yolk custard atop robusta coffee.

places.name: Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre (VIP Show)
places.desc: VIP front-row seated traditional folklore puppet performance with live folk orchestra.

places.name: Namaste Hanoi (North Indian Dinner)
places.desc: Yellow dal tadka, paneer butter masala, piping hot tandoori rotis and jeera rice.

shoppingGems.tip: Test YKK metal zippers on the spot.
Packs completely flat in hand luggage.

itinerary.title: Ninh Binh Day Tour: Hoa Lu Ancient Capital & Tam Coc Karsts
itinerary.subtitle: Private 9-seater DCar expressway drive to Ninh Binh (90 km). Explore Hoa Lu 10th-century royal temples of King Dinh & King Le, followed by a serene Tam Coc sampan boat cruise through 3 karst caves in 'Halong Bay on Land'. Return to Hanoi Old Quarter.
itinerary.seniorTip: Flat wooden boarding docks for sampan boats; shaded canopy covers for sun protection.
itinerary.keyVegMeal: Ninh Binh Chay Feast (L) & Dalcheeni Royal Indian Hanoi (D)
itinerary.limoLeg: Hanoi ⇄ Ninh Binh Full Day (90km each way)
atAGlanceHighlights: 🌅 Morning: Scenic 9-seater DCar drive to Ninh Binh & explore 10th-century Hoa Lu Ancient Capital temples
☀️ Afternoon: Tam Coc Sampan Riverboat cruise through 3 limestone karst caves ('Halong Bay on Land')
🌙 Evening: Smooth return drive to Hanoi Old Quarter, Silk street walk & Dalcheeni Royal Indian dinner

places.name: Board Private 9-Seater DCar to Ninh Binh
places.desc: Direct expressway drive south to Ninh Binh (90 km) with scheduled coffee and restroom break.

transitToNext.desc: Expressway south through Red River delta

places.name: Hoa Lu Ancient Capital (King Dinh & King Le Temples)
places.desc: 10th-century capital of ancient Vietnam before Hanoi. Shady courtyards and intricate wooden carvings of King Dinh & King Le.

places.name: Gourmet Vegetarian Lunch in Ninh Binh
places.desc: Crispy fried tofu in tomato sauce, stir-fried morning glory with garlic, and pumpkin soup.

places.name: Tam Coc Sampan Boat Cruise ('Halong Bay on Land')
places.desc: Traditional 2-hour hand-rowed sampan cruise along Ngo Dong river, gliding through Hang Ca, Hang Hai, and Hang Ba karst caves.

places.name: Return Scenic Drive to Hanoi Old Quarter
places.desc: Comfortable air-conditioned limousine ride back to Hanoi hotel.

places.name: Hàng Gai Silk & Craft Evening Walk
places.desc: Gentle stroll through Hanoi's famous silk street. Shop for pure mulberry silk scarves, lacquer boxes, and paintings.

places.name: Dalcheeni Hanoi (Royal Indian Pure Veg Dinner)
places.desc: Royal Awadhi cuisine overlooking West Lake. Dal makhani, paneer lababdar, stuffed kulchas, and saffron kheer.

shoppingGems.tip: Packs completely flat in hand luggage.
